name: draw
description: A strictly minimal diagramming tool on a precise, programmable grid. Diagrams are interactive UI as code: regions carry actions and editable inputs, and the app draws its own control bar as a diagram. The server-held document is drivable by a human or an agent over REST, and pushes to Google Slides.
